name: NOBACT 40 LPH ON-DEMAND SYSTEM
summary: The Nobact On-Demand System (Under Sink / Desktop) is a high-performance Reverse Osmosis (RO) water purifier designed to deliver purified water instantly without a storage tank.
intro: NOBACT On-Demand RO Water Purifier is a high-performance reverse osmosis system designed for domestic use with brackish water. Equipped with a 300 GPD membrane and pump, it delivers up to 40 litres per hour of purified water with efficient recovery and reliable filtration performance. Its compact countertop/under-sink design makes it suitable for modern homes.
features: Suitable for brackish water up to 2000 ppm TDS
High purification capacity of up to 40 LPH
300 GPD TFC membrane for effective purification
Multi-stage filtration: Sediment, Pre-Carbon & Post-Carbon filters
Low power consumption of 80W with 24V DC operation
Long filter life: approximately 3000 litres or 6 months
